title: Lock-contention telemetry in lock.mjs
action: On every store-lock acquire attempt outcome (success, retried success, LOCK_BUSY) append {ts, lock_name, lock_wait_ms, holder_session, caller_session, workflow_id, workspace_id, resource, result} to .bee/logs/contention.jsonl, fail-open, same append discipline as timings.jsonl. Holder session read from the lock file's owner metadata when present. Regen inside this cell after the code change: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write.

truths: fail-open append: telemetry failure never breaks the caller
LOCK_BUSY events carry holder identity when knowable
test covers success and busy paths
prohibitions: no synchronous fsync on the hot path

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check

trace.outcome: Lock-contention telemetry: withStoreLock + acquireStoreLockOnceSync append fail-open contention.jsonl records on every acquire outcome; fixed a real regression this change surfaced in test_nested_clone_isolation.mjs's fixture gitignore
